| # bds_out_aov_resetError {#bds_out_aov_reseterror-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Resets an error and unlocks the analog voltage output.

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- For more information see topic [Proportional outputs](proportional-outputs.html){.topiclink}.
